artifact_sha256_binding: The adjacent NUMERICAL_PREREGISTRATION_V2.sha256 is the SHA-256 of these exact JSON bytes.
claim_boundary: Prospective numerical repair only; not release evidence, mentor approval, biological calibration, predictive validation, or C10 closure.

proposal_source.note: The repository-native V2 is frozen from the complete values stated in the user message. It does not claim byte identity with unavailable sandbox artifacts.

preserved_v1.superseded_scope: Only the coupled grid/timestep schedule and the added clipping/temporal qualification gates are superseded. V1 and its failed outcomes remain immutable evidence.

repair_derivation.request: R_j=sum_i(A_i*J(C_j)*dt) from the common pre-O02 donor state
repair_derivation.refinement: Halving all three grid spacings divides represented one-cell donor volume by 8, so dt is also divided by 8.

trajectory_diagnostics.eta_max_run: maximum R_j/N_j over every update and donor cell with R_j>0 and N_j>0
trajectory_diagnostics.zero_inventory_positive_request: hard failure for a primary arm and reported separately rather than serialized as a nonfinite eta
trajectory_diagnostics.minimum_donor_scale_run: minimum donor scale over every update and donor cell with positive request
trajectory_diagnostics.cumulative_rejected_mol: sum of requested minus accepted uptake over the complete trajectory
trajectory_diagnostics.restart_requirement: Checkpoint and restore the cumulative ledgers and run-wide extrema so continuous and restarted diagnostics describe the same complete trajectory.

primary_no_clipping_gates.exemption_scope: Only the no-clipping gate is exempt. Conservation, exact arbitration, finite values, and requested=accepted+rejected remain mandatory.

production_grid_selection.principle: Select the coarsest passing level only when it and every finer successor satisfy every outcome and non-outcome gate for both arms.
production_grid_selection.L0: Selectable only if L0-to-L1 and L1-to-L2 pass for both arms and every non-outcome gate passes at all three levels.
production_grid_selection.L1: Selectable only if L0-to-L1 fails or does not qualify, L1-to-L2 passes for both arms, and every non-outcome gate passes at L1 and L2.
production_grid_selection.L2: Not selectable from a three-level study because it has no finer successor.

fixed_grid_temporal_confirmation.selection: Select the largest timestep for which it and both smaller successor timesteps pass.
gates: mesh-D profile L1 relative difference <= 0.05 at every observation

review_must_confirm: unchanged O02 semantics and global operator order

prohibited_repairs: select L1 only because L0 and L1 agree
use predicted saturation ratio as convergence proof
change bmx.substeps without subcycling the complete O02/O03/O04 transaction
choose an L2 timestep from the observed V1 scale
discard or relabel failed V1 evidence
start C11 before D-C10-02 is formally closed
